scope: Proposal only. GitHub Pages production is expressly authorized for this project; Hetzner remains staging. No project, account, Git or deployment changes made.

additionalPrivacyEntity.name: GitHub B.V.
additionalPrivacyEntity.scope: Also named by GitHub’s Privacy Statement; do not infer the precise contracting entity from visitor geography.

productionHosting.serverLocations: GitHub operates internationally, including in the United States and other countries. These public notices do not identify the individual server or CDN locations serving this GitHub Pages website.
productionHosting.logRetention: GitHub stores visitor IP addresses for security. No Pages-specific deletion period is stated in these notices; retention depends on the stated purposes and applicable contractual and legal requirements.
productionHosting.internationalTransfers: Personal data may be processed outside the EEA. GitHub describes EU–US Data Privacy Framework participation and Standard Contractual Clauses as safeguards for the transfers to which they apply.

de.serverLocations: GitHub ist international tätig, unter anderem in den USA und weiteren Ländern. Die verlinkten öffentlichen Hinweise benennen keine einzelnen Server- oder CDN-Standorte, von denen diese GitHub-Pages-Website ausgeliefert wird.
de.logRetention: GitHub speichert Besucher-IP-Adressen zu Sicherheitszwecken. Die verlinkten Hinweise nennen keine Pages-spezifische Löschfrist; die Aufbewahrung richtet sich nach den angegebenen Zwecken sowie vertraglichen und gesetzlichen Anforderungen.
de.internationalTransfers: Personenbezogene Daten können außerhalb des EWR verarbeitet werden. GitHub nennt die Teilnahme am EU–US Data Privacy Framework und Standardvertragsklauseln als Garantien für die jeweils davon erfassten Übermittlungen.

tr.serverLocations: GitHub, ABD ve diğer ülkeler dâhil uluslararası olarak faaliyet gösterir. Bağlantısı verilen kamuya açık bildirimler, bu GitHub Pages web sitesini sunan tek tek sunucu veya CDN konumlarını belirtmez.
tr.logRetention: GitHub, ziyaretçilerin IP adreslerini güvenlik amacıyla saklar. Bağlantılı bildirimlerde Pages’e özgü bir silme süresi belirtilmez; saklama, açıklanan amaçlara ve sözleşmesel ve yasal gerekliliklere bağlıdır.
tr.internationalTransfers: Kişisel veriler Avrupa Ekonomik Alanı dışında işlenebilir. GitHub, kapsamlarına giren aktarımlar için AB–ABD Veri Gizliliği Çerçevesine katılımı ve Standart Sözleşme Maddelerini güvence olarak belirtir.

securityLogging.scope: GitHub’s own security/abuse-prevention logging of Pages visitor IPs
securityLogging.basis: Pages documentation links security IP logging to GitHub’s controller Privacy Statement; DPA section 3.C identifies its own abuse prevention as independent-controller processing.

otherHostingProcessing.scope: Any customer-instructed hosting or personal-data processing beyond GitHub’s own security activity
otherHostingProcessing.basis: No blanket Pages role or actual plan-specific DPA coverage has been established.

en.visitorLogging: We use GitHub Pages to deliver this website. GitHub states that visitors’ IP addresses are logged and stored for security, including visitors who are not signed in to GitHub.
en.roleExplanation: GitHub describes its own security and abuse-prevention processing as independent-controller processing.

de.visitorLogging: Wir verwenden GitHub Pages zur Bereitstellung dieser Website. Nach GitHubs Angaben werden Besucher-IP-Adressen zu Sicherheitszwecken protokolliert und gespeichert, auch bei nicht bei GitHub angemeldeten Besuchern.
de.roleExplanation: GitHub beschreibt seine eigene Verarbeitung zur Sicherheit und Missbrauchsabwehr als Verarbeitung in eigener Verantwortlichkeit.

tr.visitorLogging: Bu web sitesini sunmak için GitHub Pages kullanıyoruz. GitHub, hesabına giriş yapmamış ziyaretçiler dâhil ziyaretçilerin IP adreslerini güvenlik amacıyla kaydettiğini ve sakladığını belirtir.
tr.roleExplanation: GitHub, kendi güvenlik ve kötüye kullanımı önleme işlemlerini bağımsız veri sorumlusu olarak yürüttüğünü açıklar.

agreementReview.basis: The owner explicitly instructed us to assume acceptance. Current published Google Workspace online terms incorporate the CDPA through URL Terms; this tenant’s applicable agreement/acceptance has not been independently inspected.
agreementReview.verificationLimit: Owner-authorized operational assumption, not verified account acceptance; no contract accepted by the agent.

validatorHandling.providerRule: Replace the obsolete Hetzner-only production test with the project-specific GitHub Pages production exception; retain Hetzner for staging.
validatorHandling.locationsAndRetention: The truthful published criteria and explicit absence of a fixed Pages-specific period are complete disclosures of the established facts, not empty placeholders. Do not invent locations or a deletion-day count to satisfy validation.
validatorHandling.processorRule: Use scoped applicability/review states rather than universally requiring processorAgreementConfirmed=true. A documented independent-controller basis for security logging is distinct from an applicable customer DPA and does not resolve other processing roles.
validatorHandling.hostingReviewState: Security scope documented; remaining hosting-role/plan-specific agreement scope not assessed. Do not turn that uncertainty into an accepted-DPA claim.
validatorHandling.emailReviewState: Record owner-assumption separately and keep processorAgreementConfirmed=false. If release policy accepts that authorized assumption, report the explicit assumption/status instead of silently relabelling it verified.
validatorHandling.finalReview: A content review can record what was checked and its limitations. Neither these values nor a passing software check certify legal compliance. Do not claim an existing EU office, an exemption or settled territorial applicability.

productionCopyCorrections: Remove the Helsinki/Finland location and local Docker log-retention description from production notices; those belong to the isolated Hetzner environment.
Do not say production HTTP access logging is disabled: GitHub Pages expressly stores visitor IPs for security.
Keep official AgroWISS name, supplied Türkiye address and registry data unchanged; no EU office is asserted.

pagesDataCollection.point: Pages-specific security IP logging applies also to signed-out visitors.

providerPrivacy.point: International processing and purpose/legal retention criteria; no fixed Pages-specific period identified in the cited notices.

roleAndTransferTerms.point: Mixed roles by purpose; published controller and processor distinctions and transfer mechanisms. Applicability to this account is not established.

dpaEligibility.point: Published DPA product eligibility does not establish universal Free/Pro Pages coverage.

pagesTerms.point: Check actual informational showcase use rather than assuming every corporate site is prohibited; transactional/SaaS restrictions differ.
